main_subject.description: An adult woman with short platinum-blonde hair and a contemplative side profile.
main_subject.wardrobe: A matte black high-neck coat with no visible labels.
main_subject.pose_and_expression: Standing still in profile among flowers, eyes directed toward the distant hills.

composition_elements.setting: A broad field of deep crimson flowers, misty mountain silhouette, and heavy overcast sky.
composition_elements.graphic_device: A thin white rectangular graphic frame centered in the image, crossed naturally by the subject's head and shoulders.
composition_elements.framing: Medium profile portrait with foreground flowers softly blurred.

lighting_and_atmosphere.lighting: Soft back-diffused cloud light forming a restrained rim around hair and profile.

technical_specs.rendering: Shallow depth of field, rich flower texture, natural skin, subtle haze, clean geometric overlay.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a 4:5 vertical high-grain fine-art film profile portrait of an adult woman with short platinum-blonde hair, a contemplative sideways gaze, and a matte black high-neck coat. Stand her in a broad field of deep crimson flowers beneath a heavy overcast sky, with misty mountains distant behind her. Add a thin white rectangular graphic frame centered in the image; her head and shoulders naturally cross its top and bottom edges. Use medium-profile framing, softly blurred foreground flowers, soft back-diffused cloud light, restrained rim light, shallow 85mm depth of field, rich flower texture, natural skin, subtle haze, and clean geometry. No text, logo, watermark, celebrity likeness, or sexualized styling.
prompt.negative_prompt: minor, celebrity likeness, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing clothing, lingerie, readable text, logo, watermark, distorted profile, malformed hands, AI artifacts

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Optional adult identity references may guide general approved traits. Flower-field and graphic-layout references are replaceable and do not supply text or brand content.
